```{r setup, include=FALSE}
raw_data <- read_excel("Data imported into Vensim.xlsx", sheet = "ProjEndVals")


years <- as.numeric(colnames(raw_data)[-1])

processed_data <- pivot_longer(
  raw_data, 
  cols = -1, 
  names_to = "Year", 
  values_to = "Value", 
  names_prefix = "Year_", # Remove any prefix like "Year_" from column names
  values_drop_na = TRUE # Drop rows with NA values in "Value"
)

# Rename the first column 
colnames(processed_data)[1] <- "Variable"

# Convert the Year column to numeric 
processed_data$Year <- as.numeric(processed_data$Year)



```

```{r}

# Upper-half logistic curve on x_start:x_end (NO extension beyond x_end)

logistic_upper_half <- function(x_start, x_end, y_start, y_end, k = 5) {
  xs <- seq(x_start, x_end, by = 1)

  numerator <- (y_end - y_start) / 0.5
  raw_curve <- numerator / (1 + exp((-k / (x_end - x_start)) * (xs - x_start))) +
    (y_end - numerator)

  bounded <- if (y_end > y_start) pmin(y_end, raw_curve) else pmax(y_end, raw_curve)

  offset <- bounded[1] - y_start
  ys <- bounded - offset

  tibble(Year = xs, Value = ys)
}

# Predict end value specifically at sim_final_time from a model fit on recent_data
fit_end_value_at_final <- function(recent_data, ftype, sim_final_time) {

  if (ftype == "linear") {
    m <- lm(Value ~ Year, data = recent_data)
    y_end <- predict(m, newdata = data.frame(Year = sim_final_time))

  } else if (ftype == "logarithmic") {
    m <- lm(log(Value) ~ Year, data = recent_data)
    y_end <- exp(predict(m, newdata = data.frame(Year = sim_final_time)))

  } else if (ftype == "saturating") {
    m <- tryCatch(
      nls(Value ~ 1/(1 + exp(-(a + b*Year))),
          data = recent_data,
          start = list(a = 0, b = 0.1),
          control = nls.control(warnOnly = TRUE, maxiter = 200)),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )

    if (is.null(m)) {
      m2 <- lm(Value ~ Year, data = recent_data)
      y_end <- predict(m2, newdata = data.frame(Year = sim_final_time))
    } else {
      y_end <- predict(m, newdata = data.frame(Year = sim_final_time))
    }

  } else stop("Unknown function type")

  as.numeric(y_end)
}


all_combined_data <- list()

for (variable in names(settings)) {

  filtered_data <- processed_data %>%
    filter(Variable == variable, !is.na(Value)) %>%
    arrange(Year)

  ftype <- settings[[variable]]$function_type
  if (ftype %in% c("logarithmic", "saturating")) {
    filtered_data <- filtered_data %>% filter(Value > 0)
  }

  last_years_n <- settings[[variable]]$last_years
  recent_data <- tail(filtered_data, min(last_years_n, nrow(filtered_data)))

  if (nrow(recent_data) < 2) next

  if (ftype == "linear") {
    model <- lm(Value ~ Year, data = recent_data)
  } else if (ftype == "logarithmic") {
    model <- lm(log(Value) ~ Year, data = recent_data)
  } else if (ftype == "saturating") {
    model <- tryCatch(
      nls(Value ~ 1/(1 + exp(-(a + b*Year))),
          data = recent_data,
          start = list(a = 0, b = 0.1),
          control = nls.control(warnOnly = TRUE, maxiter = 200)),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (is.null(model)) {
      model <- lm(Value ~ Year, data = recent_data)
      ftype <- "linear"
    }
  } else stop("Invalid function type.")

  last_year <- max(recent_data$Year)
  future_years <- (last_year + 1):sim_final_time
  if (length(future_years) == 0) next

  if (ftype == "linear") {
    future_values <- predict(model, newdata = data.frame(Year = future_years))
    fitted_values <- predict(model, newdata = recent_data)
  } else if (ftype == "logarithmic") {
    future_values <- exp(predict(model, newdata = data.frame(Year = future_years)))
    fitted_values <- exp(predict(model, newdata = recent_data))
  } else {
    future_values <- predict(model, newdata = data.frame(Year = future_years))
    fitted_values <- predict(model, newdata = recent_data)
  }

  projection <- data.frame(Year = future_years, Value = future_values, Type = "Projected")
  fitted     <- data.frame(Year = recent_data$Year, Value = fitted_values, Type = "Fitted")
  actual     <- data.frame(Year = filtered_data$Year, Value = filtered_data$Value, Type = "Actual")

  combined_data <- rbind(actual, fitted, projection)
  combined_data$Variable <- variable
  all_combined_data[[variable]] <- combined_data
}

final_combined_data <- do.call(rbind, all_combined_data)

f_var <- "fentanyl penetration"

if (f_var %in% names(scenario_use)) {
  # last observed fentanyl point (from processed_data)
  f_obs <- processed_data %>%
    filter(Variable == f_var, !is.na(Value)) %>%
    arrange(Year)

  x0 <- max(f_obs$Year)
  y0 <- f_obs$Value[f_obs$Year == x0][1]

  if (x0 < sim_final_time) {
    y_end <- scenario_use[[f_var]]$Base

    # build S-curve from last observed -> sim_final_time
    f_scurve <- logistic_upper_half(x0, sim_final_time, y0, y_end, k = 5)

    # Replace the projected segment in final_combined_data for fentanyl
    final_combined_data <- final_combined_data %>%
      filter(!(Variable == f_var & Type == "Projected")) %>%
      bind_rows(
        tibble(
          Year = f_scurve$Year[f_scurve$Year > x0],   # only future years
          Value = f_scurve$Value[f_scurve$Year > x0],
          Type = "Projected",
          Variable = f_var
        )
      ) %>%
      arrange(Variable, Year)
  }
}


base_info <- list()
all_base_data <- list()

for (v in names(settings)) {

  df <- processed_data %>%
    filter(Variable == v, !is.na(Value)) %>%
    arrange(Year)

  ftype <- settings[[v]]$function_type
  if (ftype %in% c("logarithmic", "saturating")) df <- df %>% filter(Value > 0)
  if (nrow(df) < 2) next

  recent_data <- df %>% tail(min(settings[[v]]$last_years, nrow(df)))

  x0 <- max(df$Year)
  y0 <- df$Value[df$Year == x0][1]

  obs_df <- df %>%
    mutate(Scenario = "Observed") %>%
    select(Year, Value, Variable, Scenario)

  if (x0 >= sim_final_time) {
    all_base_data[[v]] <- obs_df
    next
  }

  # Base end value:
  # - fentanyl: Base end value from the scenario list
  # - others: end value from model prediction at 2036
  
  if (v == "fentanyl penetration" && v %in% names(scenario_use) && !is.null(scenario_use[[v]]$Base)) {
    y_end_base <- scenario_use[[v]]$Base
  } else {
    y_end_base <- fit_end_value_at_final(recent_data, ftype, sim_final_time)
  }

  base_info[[v]] <- list(
    base_last_year  = x0,
    base_last_value = y0,
    base_end_year   = sim_final_time,
    base_end_value  = y_end_base
  )

  base_curve <- logistic_upper_half(x0, sim_final_time, y0, y_end_base, k = 5) %>%
    mutate(Variable = v, Scenario = "Base") %>%
    select(Year, Value, Variable, Scenario)

  all_base_data[[v]] <- bind_rows(obs_df, base_curve)
}

base_scenario_data <- bind_rows(all_base_data)


all_scenario_data <- list()

for (v in names(base_info)) {

  x0       <- base_info[[v]]$base_last_year
  y0       <- base_info[[v]]$base_last_value
  x_end    <- sim_final_time
  base_val <- base_info[[v]]$base_end_value

  var_data <- base_scenario_data %>% filter(Variable == v)

  # start with Observed + Base
  out_df <- bind_rows(
    var_data %>% filter(Scenario == "Observed"),
    var_data %>% filter(Scenario == "Base")
  )

  if (!v %in% names(scenario_use)) {
    all_scenario_data[[v]] <- out_df
    next
  }

  if (v == "fentanyl penetration") {
    # fentanyl end values come directly from scenario list
    y_end_opt  <- scenario_use[[v]]$Optimistic
    y_end_pess <- scenario_use[[v]]$Pessimistic

  } else {
    y_end_opt  <- base_val * scenario_use[[v]]$Optimistic
    y_end_pess <- base_val * scenario_use[[v]]$Pessimistic
  }

  opt_curve <- logistic_upper_half(x0, x_end, y0, y_end_opt,  k = 5) %>%
    mutate(Variable = v, Scenario = "Optimistic")

  pess_curve <- logistic_upper_half(x0, x_end, y0, y_end_pess, k = 5) %>%
    mutate(Variable = v, Scenario = "Pessimistic")

  out_df <- bind_rows(out_df, opt_curve, pess_curve)
  all_scenario_data[[v]] <- out_df
}

scenario_data <- bind_rows(all_scenario_data)

```

```{r ,  fig.width=15, fig.height=10}
three_scenario_plot <- ggplot(scenario_data, aes(x = Year, y = Value, color = Scenario)) +
```

```{r}


end_summaries <- scenario_data %>%
  filter(Scenario %in% c("Base", "Optimistic", "Pessimistic")) %>%
  group_by(Variable, Scenario) %>%
  summarize(
    end_Year  = max(Year),
    end_Value = Value[Year == end_Year][1],
    .groups   = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    end_Value = case_when(
      end_Value > 100 ~ round(end_Value, 0),
      end_Value > 1   ~ round(end_Value, 2),
      TRUE            ~ round(end_Value, 3)  
    ),
    end_Value = comma(end_Value)
  )

cat("\nScenario End Summaries:\n")
print(end_summaries)
```

```{r compare-cin}
# Save the end values and compare them with the values entered in the Vensim .cin files
fwrite_end <- end_summaries
write.csv(fwrite_end, file.path(figures_dir, "Table S1_projection end values.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

read_cin <- function(file, scenario) {
  x <- readLines(file, warn = FALSE)
  x <- trimws(x[grepl("^Projection curve end value", x)])
  tibble(Variable = trimws(sub("^Projection curve end value (.*?)\\s*=.*$", "\\1", x)),
         Scenario = scenario,
         cin_value = as.numeric(trimws(sub("^.*=\\s*", "", x))))
}
cin_values <- bind_rows(read_cin("ProjEndValsCA_base.cin", "Base"),
                        read_cin("ProjEndValsCA_optimistic.cin", "Optimistic"),
                        read_cin("ProjEndValsCA_pessimistic.cin", "Pessimistic"))

end_values_numeric <- scenario_data %>%
  filter(Scenario %in% c("Base", "Optimistic", "Pessimistic"), Year == sim_final_time) %>%
  select(Variable, Scenario, R_value = Value)

cin_check <- end_values_numeric %>%
  left_join(cin_values, by = c("Variable", "Scenario")) %>%
  mutate(pct_difference = round(100 * (cin_value - R_value) / R_value, 2)) %>%
  arrange(Variable, Scenario)

knitr::kable(cin_check, digits = 4)
```
